items.title: Can Navy Network Modernization Support Leidos' Growth Outlook?
items.summary: LDOS' $875M Navy contract extension expands its defense IT role, supports 650,000+ personnel and adds revenue visibility amid network modernization.

items.title: What Are You Actually Buying In RKLB Stock?
items.summary: Rocket Lab (RKLB) stock has traded between $39.48 and $150.23 over the past 52 weeks. It now sits about 58% below its 52-week high, and anyone who bought twelve months ago is still up about 19%. None of that tells you what you would be buying today. Rocket Lab sells two quite different things, and the one its name points at is the smaller of them.

items.title: Space Weapons: How Boeing, SpaceX, and Others Stand to Gain
items.summary: On Monday, the U.S. Space Force confirmed the existence of space-based weapons, though what exactly is in space is classified.  The news represents a milestone in military technology.  Space is the new strategic high ground.

items.title: Why Is Boeing Stock Falling While Revenue Soars Past Peers?
items.summary: Boeing (BA) grew revenue faster over the past twelve months than any of its aerospace and defense peers, GE Aerospace included, and its stock still fell. It is also the only one in that group running an operating loss. The growth has come with rising airplane deliveries, and the market is waiting to see whether those airplanes earn a margin.

items.title: What Has To Go Right For GE Stock To Keep Climbing?
items.summary: GE Aerospace (GE) trades near $318, up 13.4% over the past twelve months. Behind that price sits a commercial services backlog of roughly $170 billion, work on engines already flying. The easy read is that the good news is in the price, and the coming three years just work that backlog off. A three-year scenario on the company's own numbers puts a size on what is left.

items.title: Can Rising KC-46 Demand Strengthen Boeing's Defense Growth?
items.summary: BA's KC-46 contract ceiling jumps to $19.1B, expanding foreign sales and strengthening long-term defense revenue visibility through 2035.

items.title: LightPath’s Defense Pivot Could Send Shares Higher
items.summary: LightPath Technologies posted 73% YOY revenue growth and a swelling backlog as it pivots to defense optics, earning a Moderate Buy consensus despite wider net losses.
